summary: Version 2 of the TikZ figure compiles and passes the topology check. It draws A–F–B, B–D–C and A–E–C as explicit named paths, plus segments AO and OF, and two full concentric circles centred at O (radii 196.7 px and 98.5 px). All seven labels A–F and O are present. The critic scored v2 at 0.93 with must_repair=false. Its one remaining note is that OF is drawn at the same stroke weight as the other edges, whereas the original is thinner.
